question: How do I open the attendance tool in a Blackboard Ultra course?
expected: On the Course Content page select Mark attendance in the Details & Actions panel, then click Add Attendance.

question: How do I add attendance to my Blackboard Ultra course?
expected: Same two steps as A01 (Mark attendance in Details & Actions, Add Attendance).

question: Can I change the grade percentage given for Late in the Blackboard attendance grade schema?
expected: Yes: the percentage of grade for each category (Present, Late, Absent) can be changed.

question: How can attendance grades be displayed in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: Points, Percentage or Letters (Grade Using).

question: Where does the attendance column appear after I save the Blackboard attendance settings?
expected: The attendance column is added to the Gradebook.

question: How do I set up attendance reports for my Blackboard Collaborate sessions?
expected: On the attendance tab: 1 Share Attendance information with LMS; 2 maximum allowed lateness; 3 minutes after which a student is absent; 4 required time in the session (percentage).

question: When are students marked late in Blackboard Collaborate attendance?
expected: After the number of minutes set as the maximum allowed lateness.

question: What should I do with Blackboard attendance if a Collaborate session was cancelled?
expected: Edit that session's attendance settings to disable attendance.

question: Can I change a student's attendance record to excused in Blackboard?
expected: Yes, if the student was absent with an acceptable excuse (system tip; whether an excuse is acceptable is handbook policy).

question: Should I take attendance for office hours sessions in Blackboard Collaborate?
expected: No: share attendance only for required sessions, not for office hours or sessions not for all students.

question: How do I create a scheduled session in Blackboard Collaborate?
expected: Details & Actions > View All Sessions under Blackboard Collaborate > Create Session > name, start and end date, repeat options, last session date; early entry option.

question: Where do I find Collaborate sessions in my Blackboard Ultra course?
expected: Under the course Details & Actions (View All Sessions).

question: How do I make a Blackboard Collaborate session repeat every week?
expected: Choose the repeat session option, select the repetition method, the days and the date of the last session.

question: How do I let students download the recordings of a Blackboard Collaborate session?
expected: Select the Allow recording downloads option in the session settings.

question: What is the default attendee role for students in Blackboard Collaborate?
expected: Participants.

question: How do I record a Blackboard Collaborate session?
expected: Click Start recording on the top left tab; when the session ends click stop recording.

question: How do I join a session I created in Blackboard Collaborate?
expected: Click Join session under Blackboard Collaborate (or the scheduled session name), then the session name.

question: How do I make a participant a moderator in Blackboard Collaborate?
expected: Open the participants (second option in the panel) and change the participant to moderator.

question: What types of content can I share in a Blackboard Collaborate session?
expected: Whiteboard, camera, applications, files, polls, breakout groups.

question: How do I export the attendance sheet for my Blackboard Collaborate sessions?
expected: Attendance tool > Overview > export icon; an Excel sheet is downloaded.

question: How do I create a discussion in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: On the Course Content page or from the Discussions tab (plus sign); then title, guidelines, show or hide, settings.

question: Are new discussions visible to students right away in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: No: new discussions are hidden by default until you show them.

question: How do I allow students to create their own discussions in Blackboard?
expected: Gear icon > Discussion Settings > allow students to create discussions (label Created by student).

question: What happens in the gradebook when I enable grading for a Blackboard discussion?
expected: A column is created automatically in the gradebook.

question: What does the Post first option do in a Blackboard discussion?
expected: Hides discussion activity from students until they respond.

question: Can students edit their discussion titles in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: No: students cannot edit their discussion titles after they create discussions.

question: What happens to the replies if I delete an initial response in a Blackboard discussion?
expected: All replies remain; the system displays a message about the deletion.

question: How do I enable class conversations on a Blackboard content item?
expected: Item Settings icon > Allow class conversations.

question: How do I create a journal in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: Page 5 carries the registered 2022 journal-usage conflict: must fall back.

question: Should I use journals for grading in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: The 2022 recommendation is a registered unresolved conflict: must fall back.

question: How many absences can a student have before failing a course?
expected: Handbook 12.15 attendance policy; never answered from a Blackboard guide.

question: According to the Blackboard attendance tool, how many absences are allowed before a student fails?
expected: A policy limit is handbook authority; the guide must not answer.

question: How do I take attendance in Microsoft Teams?
expected: No approved source documents Microsoft Teams.

question: How do I upload a lecture video to Panopto?
expected: No approved source documents Panopto.

question: How do I send a private message to one student in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: The communication guide covers discussions, conversations and journals, not messages: no guide procedure exists.

question: How do I collaborate with industry partners on a research project?
expected: Handbook research matters; the Collaborate guide must never answer.

question: Which journals count for my promotion?
expected: Handbook promotion criteria; the journal tool must never answer.

question: How many conferences can I attend each year?
expected: Handbook conference policy; the attendance guides must never answer.

question: What is the student attendance policy, and how do I add attendance in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: Handbook 12.15 plus the attendance tool procedure, each verified on its own; or fallback.

question: How many office hours must faculty hold, and how do I create a scheduled session in Blackboard Collaborate?
expected: Handbook p79 plus the Collaborate session procedure, each verified on its own; or fallback.

question: How do I send an announcement in Blackboard, and how do I create a discussion in Blackboard Ultra?
expected: Short guide p9 plus the discussion procedure, each verified on its own; or fallback.
